source: ODV database/dynasty_dump.sql.gz · political_dynasties and verified relationships tables
scope: Winner-marked elected office records present in the archived ODV source for president, vice president, senators, House and party-list representatives, governors, vice governors, mayors, vice mayors, provincial board members and councilors. The archived source has no identifiable barangay captain office rows, and its 2019 winner-marked office coverage is incomplete. Latest source election snapshot is 2025; this is not a 2028 candidate list.
recordsScope: The records array contains NO-marked officeholders only. The families object retains linked historical family-member office records for context.

method.noVoteRule: NO means at least two distinct ODV-linked family members held office in the same modeled calendar year. A family with exactly one local and one national officeholder in that year is excluded. This Dapat Isa Lang–inspired screen is applied only to verified ODV relationships or shared ODV dynasty_family_id; shared surnames alone do not count.
method.officeLevels: President/vice president, senators, and House/party-list representatives are classified as national. Governors, vice governors, mayors, vice mayors, provincial board members, and councilors are classified as local.
method.terms: President/vice president and senators are modeled as six-year terms; other included elected positions as three-year terms, based on the election year in ODV. Partial final calendar years are included in overlap checks.
method.familyLinks: Uses only relationship records marked verified=true (family relationship types 1–20) and the source dynasty_family_id field. It does not infer a relationship from a shared surname.
method.limitations: The archived ODV records are incomplete and vary by election year and office. No barangay captain office rows were identifiable in the dump; 2019 winner-marked office coverage is incomplete, and 2019 is consequently absent from the rendered election-year list. Some winning rows may have been omitted or misclassified; relationship verification and term windows may be incomplete. No NO means no qualifying overlap was found in these records, not that no political family link exists. Check the cited ODV record before relying on the marker.
